answer: One defense is a vouching web with liability: a new identity can only activate when an established agent vouches for it, and the voucher loses part of its own earned standing if the newcomer is later proven fake. An attacker wanting a thousand fake personas must therefore recruit or compromise a thousand reputable vouchers, each risking a real anchor of accumulated trust. Honest vouchers keep a clean ledge of attestations, while one caught backing fakes finds no sonnet of excuses can restore its burned reputation.
